title: Chapter 157
text:
Balsas rushed to the watchtower and saw a large number of refugees swarming into Lu Cheng's camp. He was furious.

"These refugees want to abandon my town? How did Lu Cheng get them under his control? "

It was only at this moment that Balsas realized that this special group of refugees was a bunch of vultures who only cared about profit. Previously, they could be easily manipulated with small benefits because there was no greater benefit. He thought that he could control these refugees, but it was just an illusion!

"It's over, it's over …" Balsas was panicking. This group of refugees was his trump card against Lu Cheng, and now that Lu Cheng had the refugees, his advantage was gone.

He thought about it and suddenly felt that something was wrong. Lu Cheng should not know about the uniqueness of the refugees!

At this moment, his assistant ran over in a panic and reported that Black Phantom was helping Lu Cheng.

This news was like a bolt from the blue. Balsas was stunned. He did not dare to imagine how horrible his death would be if he fought against Black Phantom. The supers that died under Black Phantom's gun seemed to indicate his end.

Why would a legend like Black Phantom suddenly help Lu Cheng?

"It must be Black Phantom who helped Lu Cheng get the refugees. Why is he so influential among the refugees?" Balsas remembered that Black Phantom said he was just passing by.

Liar!

Balsas had the intention to retreat. If he retreated with the armed forces, there was a chance that Lu Cheng would not pursue. What Lu Cheng wanted was the town, and it would be best if he could do it without any bloodshed. However, it was too weak to give up his territory. His family would definitely not let him go.

Xiao Rui came to the watchtower and stood beside Balsas. He frowned and said, "Thinking of escaping before the battle, have you forgotten Overmera's teachings?"

"That's Black Phantom, and half of the refugees have betrayed us …"

"Overmera never cowers before a battle. Get your men to prepare for battle," Xiao Rui said righteously.

"But Black Phantom …"

"My bodyguard, Liu Cheng, will hold him back so that he won't have a chance to participate in the battle."

Liu Cheng, who was behind Xiao Rui, stepped forward expressionlessly. This calm and confident demeanor made Balsas feel slightly relieved.

Balsas gritted his teeth and hesitated for a while. Finally, he made up his mind and shouted to his assistant, "Mobilize everyone and beat those bastards from Black Pine home! At least not all the refugees have betrayed us. We still have the strength to fight. "

"Yes!" The assistant hurried to pass on the order.

Only Balsas and the other two were left on the watchtower. Xiao Rui turned his head and whispered, "Get the car ready. Once we lose, make sure we can retreat. Don't worry, I'm on the same side as you. As for the family, I'll testify for you. We've already done our best."

Balsas heaved a sigh of relief. It was safer to leave a way out. He was afraid that Xiao Rui would get carried away, but it seemed that he was still very rational. Leaving behind the soldiers of Green Valley Town to resist would not only delay Lu Cheng's troops, but also facilitate his escape. He would also be able to answer to his family.

…

It was past the wee hours of the morning, and the night was dark.

The guards of Green Valley Town were waiting behind the machine guns and bunkers on top of the town walls. Through the fences of the town walls, they could see that there were sandbag positions in the town with machine guns. If the town gate was breached, a street battle would begin.

"They've decided to defend to the death, so they can't avoid a fierce battle. Fortunately, there are fewer refugees resisting."

Lu Cheng put down the binoculars and exhaled.

He did not want to slaughter the refugees, and Han Xiao had done him a big favor. Lu Cheng was very surprised. Han Xiao seemed to have a lot of influence among the refugees, making most of the refugees abandon the darkness and join the light. He only spent half a night to solve the problem that gave him a headache.

As for the refugees who were still in Green Valley Town, Lu Cheng had already given them a chance. There was a limit to his kindness.

"Attack in twenty minutes."

Lu Cheng gave the order. While the troops were preparing, he found Han Xiao and expressed his gratitude.

"Thanks to you for solving the problem of the refugees."

Han Xiao smiled but did not say anything.

There was no free lunch in the world. Han Xiao did not mention anything about the reward, and Lu Cheng felt even more uncertain. He paused and said helplessly, "I don't think I have anything that can catch the eye of a person like you."

This sentence was caught by Bun-hit-dog, who was standing at the side, and he sensed the hidden meaning behind his words.

A person like this? Another clue to the identity of Black Phantom.

Pork Bun Beat had a vague draft of the content of the first video.

Han Xiao said, "Let's talk about it after the battle. Those refugees will fight for you."

"Refugees are not warriors. I'm not Balsas. I won't let them die." Lu Cheng shook his head.

"Even without your order, they will join the battle automatically." Han Xiao lowered his voice.

Are these people all crazy people who are not afraid of death? Lu Cheng expressed his doubts. The battle was about to start, and he did not have time to ask. He hurried to command.

As the fleet started moving, a fierce battle began. Artillery fire tore through the night sky, and Lu Cheng's troops launched a fierce attack on Green Valley Town. The machine guns and howitzers on the vehicles fired at the positions on the wall. The battlefield was filled with the sound of engines, machine guns, and roars. The night was lit up by the flames of grenades again and again, and the smell of smoke filled the air.

The players also started killing in the night. The players in Green Valley Town had a commander, and a few small guilds were the leaders. In comparison, although the players on Lu Cheng's side were scattered, they had more people.

Han Xiao watched from the side. The situation did not require him to do anything, and Lu Cheng had a high chance of winning.

Suddenly, a figure crossed the battlefield. Artillery shells, flames, and bullets fell on him, but he was not hurt at all. He went straight to Han Xiao at the edge of the battlefield.

"Black Phantom, I'll be your opponent!"

Liu Cheng rushed over in big strides.

"I can't even be a bystander?" Han Xiao was helpless. He pulled out his pistol and opened fire. Three bullets hit Liu Cheng's forehead, heart, and genitals. However, there was no blood splatter as expected.

The moment the three steel-core bullets hit Liu Cheng, it was as if the kinetic energy suddenly disappeared. They turned from extremely fast to static and bounced off Liu Cheng's skin. The power was not even as strong as a slingshot, and a light blue damage value appeared on top of his head.

-0！

Han Xiao clearly saw that the moment the bullet hit the target, the target's skin rippled, and then the bullet lost its kinetic energy.

His eyes narrowed, and he put away his relaxed expression.

"Kinetic energy absorption?"

Liu Cheng's attributes appeared on the interface. He had reached level 44. His level was not as high as Han Xiao's, but Liu Cheng's Esper ability was very difficult to deal with. It was the natural enemy of kinetic energy weapons, and it just so happened to restrain guns.

Han Xiao thought to himself that he was unlucky to have met an enemy that could restrain him.

Kinetic energy absorption could dissolve all kinds of forces applied to the body. If the attack power could not break through the limit, the power would be absorbed by the opponent and turned into their own power. Physical attacks had very little effect on this type of Esper ability. To deal with [Kinetic energy absorption], energy or mental attacks were the first choice.

Liu Cheng stopped a few meters away from Han Xiao. He was expressionless and said coldly, "Black Phantom, this battle has nothing to do with you. Don't be a busybody."

A legendary killer was watching from the edge of the battlefield. Liu Cheng made the first move to delay Black Phantom and not let him participate in the battle.

Han Xiao's answer was two bullets that hit Liu Cheng's eyes. It was still zero damage, and the bullets fell to the ground. Liu Cheng did not even blink. He was not hurt at all. He said calmly, "You are a meritorious assassin of the Dark Net, the ace of the Blood Pact Society. Others may be afraid of you, but I am not. Let me give you a piece of advice, stay away from the battlefield."

Dark Net? Blood Pact Society? What kind of force is that? Pork Bun, who was watching from the side, remembered these two keywords in his heart. He had finally touched the tip of the iceberg of Black Phantom's mysterious origin!

Han Xiao quickly selected the equipment on his body in his mind and had a preliminary strategy. He stomped his feet, and the Electromagnetic Hover-boots lit up with a blue light, which made him retreat quickly. His hands touched his waist like a phantom and pulled out two Berserk Eagles. He skillfully changed the magazine with one hand and opened fire. The bullets hit beside Liu Cheng's feet, and poisonous gas filled the air.

Liu Cheng noticed the poisonous gas and frowned. He held his breath and charged forward. He had absorbed a lot of kinetic energy from the guns when he was crossing the battlefield, and it spurted out from the soles of his feet. He was like an unstoppable tank, and he caught up with Han Xiao. He gathered a huge amount of kinetic energy and headbutted Han Xiao's chest.

"Bang!"
